api-reference-page.versionEveryRouteFromApiOpenapi: Version {version} · every route, from /v1/openapi.json · Using the API

page.aSubagentAtClaudeAgentsName: A subagent at .claude/agents/'<'name'>'.md deploys as an agent here — no conversion. init also writes a CLAUDE.md so your editor knows the conventions instead of guessing.
page.agentsAreJustFoldersAndFlows: Agents are just folders and flows are numbered lists, so there is no build step: edit, check, run, deploy. Start on your own machine — none of it needs an account.
page.checkIsFreeAndCatchesA: check is free and catches a broken flow at push time rather than at 3am when its schedule fires. Run it after edits, the way you would run a typecheck.
page.theWholeGrammarOnOnePage: The whole grammar on one page — every field an agent or a flow can carry, and what each one does. The page to keep open while editing.
